AirBridge Pro mirroring — third-party software
=============================================

Pro mirroring uses two unmodified third-party programs, bundled in this app's Resources folder.

1. scrcpy server 5.0.1 (file: scrcpy-server-v5.0.1)
   Runs on the Android phone while it is mirrored.
   Source: https://github.com/Genymobile/scrcpy (tag v5.0.1)
   Release file: scrcpy-server-v5.0.1
   SHA-256: 764eb6f79811d5211fe9df341120882ba9994c7a61b897d7bf3fb662e53bc536
   (matches SHA256SUMS.txt of the v5.0.1 release)

   Copyright (C) 2018 Genymobile
   Copyright (C) 2018-2026 Romain Vimont

   Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0 (the "License");
   you may not use this file except in compliance with the License.
   You may obtain a copy of the License at

       http://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

   Unless required by applicable law or agreed to in writing, software
   distributed under the License is distributed on an "AS IS" BASIS,
   WITHOUT WARRANTIES OR CONDITIONS OF ANY KIND, either express or implied.
   See the License for the specific language governing permissions and
   limitations under the License.

   The full license text is in scrcpy-LICENSE.txt.
   AirBridge talks to this server with its own client code; no scrcpy client code is included.

2. adb (Android Debug Bridge) from Android SDK Platform-Tools 37.0.1 for macOS (file: adb)
   Runs on this Mac to pair with and connect to the phone over Wireless debugging.
   Download: https://dl.google.com/android/repository/platform-tools_r37.0.1-darwin.zip
   Archive SHA-1 (Google's repository manifest): 6ae73f4de6452dc57e62ec02b68eed92a4c21661
   Archive SHA-256: ee39ad5967e95c2a07f04dbcbde96b1a0c916ba376096db5d2f498b7727a5d1d
   Binary SHA-256: 1811e253b21b12cbfda7201ebaf86c10e7ddcb5c606a7a81f7c82b4c429c2d3b
   Signed by Google LLC (Developer ID, Team EQHXZ8M8AV); bundled unmodified.

   adb is part of the Android Open Source Project and is licensed under the Apache License 2.0.
   The licenses of adb and the libraries it contains are listed in android-platform-tools-NOTICE.txt
   (the NOTICE.txt shipped with Platform-Tools).
